description: Check whether an Expo native project needs a clean prebuild for iOS or Android. Compares current dependencies and app config with that platform's last successful-build snapshot; iOS also checks Podfile.lock, while Android checks the package-manager lockfile used to resolve native packages.

platform.description: Platform to inspect; defaults to the active Ceraph platform.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

name: rn_check_prebuild
